title: 2011 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: Karl’s rectangular vegetable garden is \(20\) feet by \(45\) feet, and Makenna’s is \(25\) feet by \(40\) feet. Whose garden is larger in area?

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: Karl’s garden is larger by \(100\) square feet.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: Karl’s garden is larger by \(25\) square feet.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: The gardens are the same size.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: Makenna’s garden is larger by \(25\) square feet.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
Makenna’s garden is larger by \(100\) square
feet.

solutions.text:
The area of Karl’s garden is \[20 \text{ft} \cdot 45 \text{ft} = 900 \text{ft}^2.\] The area of Makenna’s garden is \[25 \text{ft} \cdot 40 \text{ft} = 1000 \text{ft}^2.\]

The difference of these areas is \[1000 \text{ft}^2 - 900 \text{ft}^2 = 100 \text{ft}^2.\] Therefore, Makenna’s garden is \(100 \text{ft}^2\) larger than Karl’s.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
